name: account-profile
text: Profile Team Billing Profile Not functional Cortex has no accounts or sign-in. This screen is an unfinished interface, not a view of your account, and nothing here is connected to a real service. Identity There is no profile to edit. Cortex runs locally and has no account system, so there is no name, email or avatar stored for you anywhere. Preferences Theme, language, and keyboard shortcuts are configured in Settings, which is where they are actually saved. This screen previously showed a second copy of those controls that looked identical but discarded every change.

name: account-team
text: Profile Team Billing Team Management Not functional Cortex has no accounts, sign-in or team backend. This screen is an unfinished interface, not a view of your account, and nothing here is connected to a real service. Members There are no team members to show. Cortex has no accounts or sign-in, so it has no notion of a team, and members cannot be listed or invited. Roles & Permissions No permissions are enforced. Cortex runs locally with the privileges of the user who started it; there is no server-side authorization to configure here.

name: account-billing
text: Profile Team Billing Billing & Usage Not functional Cortex has no subscription or billing backend. This screen is an unfinished interface, not a view of your account, and nothing here is connected to a real service. For real token and cost usage measured from your local sessions, use the Usage view under Agents. Usage and Limits There are no plans or quotas to report against. Cortex does not meter usage or enforce limits. Payment Methods No payment methods can be stored. Cortex does not process payments and is not connected to a payment provider. Invoice History No invoices exist. Cortex does not bill for usage, so there is nothing to list or download.
